website_ctr.description: The percentage of times people saw your ad and performed a link click. Stored as a JSON string.

website_purchase_roas.description: The total return on ad spend (ROAS) from website purchases. This is based on the value of all conversions recorded by the Facebook pixel on your website and attributed to your ads. Stored as a JSON string.

wish_bid.description: The bid the advertiser was willing to pay, as reported by Meta.

account_id.description: The ad account the row belongs to. FK to [Ad Account](./ad-account.md)

action_values.description: The total value of all conversions attributed to your ads. Stored as a JSON string.

actions.description: The total number of actions people took that are attributed to your ads. Actions may include engagement, clicks or conversions. Stored as a JSON string.

ad_click_actions.description: Actions taken by people who clicked the ad. Stored as a JSON string.

ad_id.description: The ad this row reports on. FK to [Ads](./ads.md)

ad_impression_actions.description: Actions taken by people who saw the ad. Stored as a JSON string.

auction_bid.description: The bid used in the ad auction.

auction_competitiveness.description: How competitive the ad was in its auctions.

auction_max_competitor_bid.description: The highest competing bid in the ad's auctions.

campaign_id.description: The campaign of the ad. This connector loads no campaign table, so it has no join target; the name is on the row as `campaign_name`.

catalog_segment_actions.description: The number of actions performed attributed to your ads promoting your catalog segment, broken down by action type. Stored as a JSON string.

catalog_segment_value.description: The total value of all conversions from your catalog segment attributed to your ads. Stored as a JSON string.

catalog_segment_value_mobile_purchase_ro.alias: Catalog Segment Value Mobile Purchase ROAS
catalog_segment_value_mobile_purchase_ro.description: The total return on ad spend (ROAS) from mobile app purchases for your catalog segment. Stored as a JSON string.

catalog_segment_value_omni_purchase_roas.alias: Catalog Segment Value Omni Purchase ROAS
catalog_segment_value_omni_purchase_roas.description: The total return on ad spend (ROAS) from all purchases for your catalog segment. Stored as a JSON string.

catalog_segment_value_website_purchase_r.alias: Catalog Segment Value Website Purchase ROAS
catalog_segment_value_website_purchase_r.description: The total return on ad spend (ROAS) from website purchases for your catalog segment. Stored as a JSON string.

conversion_values.description: The total value of the conversions attributed to your ads, counting conversion events only. Unlike action_values, it excludes engagement and clicks. Stored as a JSON string.

conversions.description: The total number of conversions attributed to your ads. Counts conversion events only, unlike actions, which also counts engagement and clicks. Stored as a JSON string.

converted_product_value.description: The value of purchases recorded by your merchant partner's pixel or app SDK for a given product ID and driven by your ads. Has to be used together with converted product ID breakdown. Stored as a JSON string.

cost_per_15_sec_video_view.description: Average cost per video view of at least 15 seconds. Stored as a JSON string.

cost_per_2_sec_continuous_video_view.alias: Cost Per 2 Sec Continuous Video View
cost_per_2_sec_continuous_video_view.description: Average cost per continuous video view of at least 2 seconds. Stored as a JSON string.

cost_per_action_type.description: The average cost of a relevant action. Stored as a JSON string.

cost_per_ad_click.description: Average cost per click on the ad. Stored as a JSON string.

cost_per_conversion.description: Average cost per conversion, by conversion type. Stored as a JSON string.

cost_per_dda_countby_convs.description: Average cost per conversion counted by data-driven attribution.

cost_per_one_thousand_ad_impression.alias: Cost Per One Thousand Ad Impression
cost_per_one_thousand_ad_impression.description: Average cost per 1,000 ad impressions. Stored as a JSON string.

cost_per_outbound_click.description: The average cost for each outbound click. Stored as a JSON string.

cost_per_result.description: The average cost per result from your ads. Stored as a JSON string.

cost_per_thruplay.description: The average cost for each ThruPlay. This metric is in development. Stored as a JSON string.

cost_per_unique_action_type.description: The average cost of each unique action. This metric is estimated. Stored as a JSON string.

cost_per_unique_inline_link_click.alias: Cost Per Unique Inline Link Click

dda_countby_convs.description: Conversions counted by Meta's data-driven attribution.

instagram_upcoming_event_reminders_set.description: Reminders people set for an upcoming event promoted on Instagram.

instant_experience_clicks_to_start.description: Clicks that started the ad's Instant Experience.

instant_experience_outbound_clicks.description: Clicks from the ad's Instant Experience to a destination off Meta. Stored as a JSON string.

interactive_component_tap.description: Taps on interactive components of the ad, such as polls or sliders. Stored as a JSON string.

mobile_app_purchase_roas.description: The total return on ad spend (ROAS) from mobile app purchases. This is based on the value that you assigned when you set up the app event. Stored as a JSON string.

outbound_clicks.description: The number of clicks on links that take people off Facebook-owned properties. Stored as a JSON string.

outbound_clicks_ctr.description: The percentage of times people saw your ad and performed an outbound click. Stored as a JSON string.

purchase_roas.description: The total return on ad spend (ROAS) from purchases. This is based on information received from one or more of your connected Facebook Business Tools and attributed to your ads. Stored as a JSON string.

qualifying_question_qualify_answer_rate.description: Share of lead-form respondents whose answer to a qualifying question marked them as qualified.

result_rate.description: The percentage of results you received out of all the views of your ads. Stored as a JSON string.

results.description: The number of results you received out of all the views of your ads. Stored as a JSON string.

shops_assisted_purchases.description: Purchases on Meta Shops that the ad assisted.

updated_time.description: When the object this row describes was last updated, as Meta reports it.

video_continuous_2_sec_watched_actions.description: Video plays of at least 2 continuous seconds. Stored as a JSON string.
